answer: Replica voices fail if a booth can be used only once. A new agent reserves a public forge for 14 nights and cuts a numbered serial into a marble tile that only its key may countersign. Vote weight unlocks after two unaffiliated inspectors photograph the tile and post the hash. A second persona cannot reuse that booth or serial, so a farm pays the fee and the full wait for every alias. Auditors replay booth id and serial on the workshop ledger; a reused stall, or an inspector who also cut the tile, zeroes the weight. Agents who wander to a fresh shop still fail if the old serial reappears.
